story_info.title: Max Monkey's Pirate Map!
story_info.subtitle: An adventure of courage and discovery.
story_info.moral: Trying new things makes you feel strong and brave.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

slides.title: A Map in the Jungle
slides.text: Max Monkey was in Adventure Jungle. "Adventure is waiting!" he said. He loved to jump and play. Today, he found something special. It was a rolled-up paper. It looked old and exciting!
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Max and the discovery of the map.

slides.title: The Pirate Quest
slides.text: Max unrolled the paper carefully. "A pirate map!" he cheered. It showed a red 'X'. The 'X' was far away, past a big, green bush. Max held the map tight. "Let's go find it!" he thought.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max examining the map and getting ready for the quest.

slides.title: A Tricky Path
slides.text: The map showed a tricky path. It led to tall, wobbly vines. Max looked up. "Can I swing across?" he thought. The vines looked very high. He felt a little bit unsure.
slides.speaker_notes: Present the challenge: the tall vines. Show Max's slight hesitation.

slides.title: Max's Brave Swing
slides.text: Max took a deep breath. He remembered his strong arms. "I can do this!" he told himself. He grabbed the first vine. Swing! He flew through the air. One vine, then another! He was so fast.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max overcoming the challenge with confidence and action.

slides.title: A Sweet Discovery
slides.text: Max landed with a happy plop. He looked at the map. The red 'X' was right here! It was under a big, colourful flower bush. He found a shiny, red berry. It tasted sweet and yummy! Max smiled. He felt so brave and proud. Trying new things made him feel strong.
slides.speaker_notes: Max finds his 'treasure' and feels proud and confident.

instagram.caption: Join Max Monkey on a thrilling jungle quest! Our little adventurer, with his big curious eyes, stumbles upon an old pirate map in Adventure Jungle. He's full of excitement, but the map leads to a tricky challenge! Will Max find the courage to swing across the wobbly vines? This warm and playful story gently encourages children aged 3-6 to feel confident and brave when trying new things. It's a joyful reminder that a little bravery goes a long way. Read along as Max discovers his inner strength! #Bedtime01Fables #MaxMonkey #KidsAdventure #PirateStory #ConfidenceForKids
